resources.title: Arithmetic sample — Study guide
resources.markdown:
# Arithmetic sample — Study guide

Original sample content for trying Recall Desk.

## Concepts and distinctions

Multiplication counts equal groups: 6 × 7 = 42. Addition combines quantities: 9 + 6 = 15.

| Operation | Example | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Multiplication | 6 × 7 | 42 |
| Addition | 9 + 6 | 15 |

## Applied practice

Predict 4 × 7 before counting four groups of seven. [Sample missing attachment](missing-worksheet.pdf) demonstrates the missing-file message.

## Transfer check

The sequence 2, 4, 6, 8 increases by two, so its next value is 10. An even integer is divisible by two; 12 is even.
